name: managed-docker-volume-recovery
goal: Keep offline worktree volume and tmpfs defaults while recovering only the exact task, staging container, and volume after supervisor death; preserve v1 bind recovery, concurrent live tasks, and synthetic Tracker relay.

evidence: Default v1 bind misses the measured volume and tmpfs layout. The independent v2 volume candidate lacks a durable host receipt, so a killed supervisor leaves a task container, staging container and volume.
Strengthen the existing adapter command contract for the volume mount and the existing CLI lifecycle case for exact volume recovery, legacy bind recovery, and a live independent task.
The existing argv case failed with the v1 bind and missing guest TMPDIR and Bun cache. Immutable red checkpoint 9dedc4afb872104f31fec7ee61f665556228f2fbcd2bc31287ee8055399846a0.

Persist versioned host intent before every Docker create. Validate engine identity, owner labels, full container IDs when known, volume identity, and exact mount scopes before reclaiming resources. Earlier bind receipts retain their v1 path validation.

Frozen test corpus red at ae0e4df448 (85911116838d), unchanged green at 909a50cd0b (aebfd87305c7), same isolated shell/runtime profile. Related local unit checks and synthetic cleanup scope checks passed. Exact MB2 Docker and relay proof remains pending.
